name: Radisson Blu Resort & Spa Alibaug
why_special: Radisson's 169-room beach resort 4 km from Alibaug town on Awas beach — large free-form pool, full-service spa, kids' club. The default chain-5-star Alibaug stay for Mumbai weekend families that want pool over heritage.

name: U Tropicana Alibaug
why_special: U Hotels' 47-cottage resort across landscaped grounds with one of the longest pools in Alibaug — full spa, kids' club, multi-cuisine restaurant. The Mumbai weekend-resort default with the most consistent reviews on Tripadvisor.

name: Fariyas Resort Alibaug
why_special: Fariyas Group resort on Varsoli beach — direct beach access, outdoor pool, the closest 4-star to Alibaug fort. The historical pick for the Alibaug weekend before the chain 5-stars arrived; still the strongest beach-walkout.

name: Acron Waterfront Resort Alibaug
why_special: Goa-based Acron Group's Alibaug resort with infinity pool overlooking the Arabian Sea — 60 rooms, multi-cuisine restaurant, the boutique mid-range pick between the Radisson 5-star and value beach homestays.
